AeroShield: Active Electromagnetic Nanoscale Shield for Space Dust Repulsion

AeroShield is an active electromagnetic nanoscale shield designed to repel razor-sharp lunar and Martian dust from spacesuits. By integrating carbon nanotubes into fabrics and applying transparent conductive coatings, the system uses Coulomb’s Law to deflect micro-dust before contact. Lightweight and energy-efficient, AeroShield ensures ultimate astronaut safety and mission longevity in deep space.
